problem: China comprehensive saved-case adapter previously ignored claimed_deductions, carried_losses and foreign_tax_paid while producing a successful domestic calculation.
change: Require the saved manual deduction total to equal allowed special, additional, other and donation deductions. Automatic CNY60000 basic deduction and income-category expense reductions remain separate. Reject nonzero carried losses and foreign taxes in this domestic comprehensive policy rather than silently losing those facts. Explain the convention in both UI languages.
legal_scope: Article 6 separates basic, special, additional and other deductions, and qualifying donations. Exact equality between the two application inputs is an application consistency invariant, not an additional statutory deduction condition.
